name: TeamTravelLogisticsPlanner
tagline: Plan every away trip – travel party, rooming, transport, matchday timings, kit and budget – in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete away-trip planning app for clubs, academies, colleges and national squads. Team managers see the travel party, drag players and staff into rooms, check transport seats and arrival time against kick-off, keep the pre-match meal in its window, tick off the kit manifest and track committed spend against the trip budget – with a readiness score and a Needs-attention list driven by configurable rules. Works with demo data the moment it is dropped on a canvas screen, model-driven form or Power Pages page.
features: Readiness score and Needs-attention list (arrival buffer, pre-match meal window, seats, leg overlap, rooming, kit, budget, confirmations)
Drag & drop rooming with auto-assign and player/staff separation
Matchday timeline with time relative to kick-off
Transport seat check against the travel party
Kit manifest with tick-to-pack and bulk packed/loaded
Trip budget with committed, paid, estimated and cost per traveller
Trip workflow with guarded steps and reasons
Share itinerary and rooming list export via Power Fx
Search, filters, grouping, bulk status, CSV export, delete with undo
Phone layout with bottom navigation; keyboard and screen-reader support
controlType: standard (data-set control + Power Pages field control from one src/app)
